title: The Lower shelf in the cupboard
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：lower　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lower 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the operator wrote of ① a lower shelf in the cupboard in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so lower that nobody in the station would go near it. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the lower ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the lower shelf in the cupboard that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log for June 1955 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too lower to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the lower ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a lower price for the wool, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as lower as the price for the wool they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was lower or not, and he said so.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something lower, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite lower; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the lower ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971, in silence, she wrote of another lower shelf in the cupboard in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ no less lower than anybody had expected. ⑩ The lower price for the wool that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1973, was the one she could never quite name; the lower ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 较低（前置定语 a lower shelf in the cupboard：1961 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件较低的下层隔板）
B. adj. 较低／下层（两处加强说法：so lower that … 与 no less lower than …）
C. adj. 较低／下层（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 较低（表语 too lower to do：母亲觉得它太较低，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 下层（前置定语 a lower price for the wool：叔叔把整件事称作一桩下层的价钱）
F. adj. 下层（同级比较 as lower as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩羊毛较低的价钱相比）
G. adj. 下层（后置定语 something lower：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 下层（受程度副词修饰 quite lower：那位实习生的评价）

items.q: a lower shelf in the cupboard
the lower shelf in the cupboard that
a lower price for the wool
The lower price for the wool that

answers.why: lower 意为“较低”，1961 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件较低的下层隔板”，此处作前置定语 a lower shelf in the cupboard。
lower 意为“较低”，此处用 so lower that 结构，说它较低到机房里没人敢靠近。
lower 意为“较低”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的较低柜子里的下层隔板，等于最高级的说法。
lower 意为“较低”，母亲认为这件东西“太较低了，谁也用不上”，too lower to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
lower 意为“下层”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩下层的价钱”，此处作前置定语 a lower price for the wool。
lower 意为“下层”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩羊毛较低的价钱一样下层”，同级比较用 as lower as。
lower 意为“下层”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“下层的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something lower。
lower 意为“下层”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当下层”，quite 修饰原级 lower。
lower 意为“下层”，no less lower than 表示“其下层不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之下层不亚于任何人的预料。
lower 意为“下层”，母亲 1973 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的下层价钱”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件较低的下层隔板。（a lower shelf in the cupboard）
它较低到机房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so lower that …）
母亲觉得它太较低，谁也用不上。（too lower to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩下层的价钱。（a lower price for the wool）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩羊毛较低的价钱一样下层。（as lower as …）
到了 1968 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件下层的东西。（something lower）
answers: In 1961 the operator wrote of a lower shelf in the cupboard in the log.
It was so lower that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too lower to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a lower price for the wool.
He said nobody would call it as lower as the price for the wool they had once had.
By 1968 the log asked for nothing but something lower.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lower 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the operator wrote of a lower shelf in the cupboard in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the lower shelf in the cupboard that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too lower to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a lower price for the wool, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite lower, and everybody laughed.
The lower ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
